replication.target_description: Narrated Southgate/Senju false-belief anticipatory-looking task, with DLS FB1 and FB2, first-saccade analyses and comparisons with a previous nonverbal replication. The supplied general description and p. 11 discussion do not distinguish a condition, measure or critical test. Current sample is 4.5–5.5 years, rather than the two-year-old original sample.

notes: Identity verified independently from the supplied text: title Testing the Role of Verbal Narration in Implicit Theory of Mind Tasks, authors Louisa Kulke and Hannes Rakoczy, DOI 10.1080/15248372.2018.1544140, Journal of Cognition and Development, published online 17 Nov 2018. Full primary journal report with Methods, Results, Discussion and References (printed pp. 1–14), not an abstract-only parse. No PDF supplied. Multiple distinct tests match the general Southgate/Senju anticipatory-looking description. Neither the supplied condition-free description nor p. 11 selects FB1 versus FB2, DLS versus first saccades, or current-study versus cross-study comparisons. Do not select by row order or numeric match. Southgate/Senju candidate tests, not assigned to a target: p. 7 FB1 DLS t(25) = 7.583, p < .001, d = 3.03 (condition n = 26); FB2 DLS t(21) = −1.466, p = .157, d = −0.64 (condition n = 22). P. 8 combined first-saccade binomial p = .388, correct n = 8, incorrect n = 4; separate FB1 p = .125 and FB2 p = 1. Cross-study first-saccade Fisher test p = .045, d = 1.10; cross-study DLS comparisons FB1 p = .537, d = 0.19 and FB2 p = .006, d = 0.93. P. 9 correlations distinguish Southgate/Senju DLS versus Surian/Geraci FB (r(40) = .415, p = .008, d = 0.91) and TB (r(40) = .112, p = .490, d = 0.23). These printed metrics and p values are kept paired and are not converted. P. 11 is discussion and does not identify one critical statistical test.  Analytic-unit candidates are children for DLS, restricted by familiarization inclusion; first-saccade tests use children with an eligible first saccade. Printed common DLS sample 48 is a candidate only. Contributor/recruitment total 67 is not assigned as analytic N. Unassigned reported_success is a placeholder only.
